changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[ArtifactSiteNavigation](@id int, @NoReadAssetTypes dbo.ids readonly) returns xml with returns null on null input begin return ( select name, url, 'Menu_AT' + cast(id as varchar(15)) as menuID, 0 as feature, disabled, case when @@nestlevel > 24 then null else dbo.ArtifactSiteNavigation(id, @NoReadAssetTypes) end as items from ( select T.ID as ID, [dbo].[XMLRemoveInValidChar](T.Name) Name, AUrl.[Url] as [Url], case when nr.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as disabled from AssetType T left join @NoReadAssetTypes nr on nr.id = t.id outer apply ( select IT.SubjectAssetTypeID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) IT cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl where IT.SubjectAssetTypeID = @id ) BG order by name for xml path('nav'), type ) end
